candidates.description: A standardized scale used to assess the functional status and degree of impairment of cancer patients.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Locate the 'Assessment' or 'Plan' sections and extract the digit associated with 'ECOG'.
candidates.measurement_definition: The numeric grade (0-5) explicitly documented as 'ECOG' or 'ECOG performance status'.
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: The evidence only demonstrates values 1 and 2; the full range of the categorical scale is assumed based on standard clinical practice.

candidates.description: The cumulative lifetime exposure to tobacco, calculated as the number of packs smoked per day multiplied by the number of years smoked.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Search the 'Social History' section for the term 'pack-years' and extract the preceding numeric value.
candidates.name: Smoking History (Pack-Years)
candidates.uncertainty: It is uncertain if the value is consistently reported for all patients or only for those categorized as 'former smokers'.

limitations: The evidence set is limited to a small number of patient records, restricting the observed range of variables.
Some baseline variables (like PD-L1) were mentioned but lacked consistent numeric formatting across the evidence for a robust continuous definition.
summary: The evidence supports the identification of baseline functional status and tobacco exposure history as measurable clinical variables associated with the patients described in the retrieval set.
